mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 73 degrees and partly cloudy along the Military Ridge State Trail. The air quality index is at a moderate 53. If you look up tonight, the ISS will be visible from 9:08 PM for four minutes, rising over Mount Horeb toward Madison near Home Depot, reaching halfway up the sky. The overnight low will be 64 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city news, the Verona Police Department reported that on September 10th, officers were called to Hunter's Cove Way for a burglary in progress. A nineteen year old was arrested and taken to a hospital for injuries sustained during the incident, and police recovered a handgun.

There is plenty to do, including live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today and at Paddy Mac's tomorrow. Also, catch the Dane County Farmer's Market tomorrow on the Capitol Square and the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival in Verona on September 13th.

Regarding local public safety, on September 10th, the Verona Police Department addressed a residential burglary and weapons offence on Hunter's Cove Way, resulting in one suspect being taken into custody.
Today's flavor of the day is Raspberry Cheesecake. Culver's is currently open and will be serving guests until 10:30 PM tonight.
